Casper cloaking film is the only window film technology specifically engineered to block LED and OLED screen content from outside view while leaving the glass visually transparent. Designed by Designtex, Casper is standard-spec for law firms, finance offices, executive suites, boardrooms, and any glass-walled space with sensitive screen data. Frequently Asked Questions — Casper Privacy Cloaking Film in Arizona

How does Casper cloaking film work?

Casper uses a proprietary optical interference layer that scatters LED wavelengths at specific angles. Screens appear black to anyone outside the glass while remaining fully visible inside.

Does Casper film affect screen brightness from inside?

No. Casper has no measurable impact on screen visibility, color, or brightness for people inside the room.

Will Casper film work on all types of screens?

Casper is optimized for LED and OLED displays. It does not block projectors or traditional fluorescent-backlit displays. Modern LED monitors and TVs are fully compatible.

How much does Casper cloaking film cost?

Casper film installs at a premium price point — typically $20–$35 per square foot installed, depending on glass size and accessibility. Contact us for a site-specific quote.

Is Casper film available for residential use?

Yes — home offices with sensitive screens, home theaters, or any residential glass application can use Casper film.
